```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# ---- Packages ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Loaded once here so that the analytical sections below contain only analytical
# code. Versions are reported in the reproducibility appendix.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(sf)                 # vector geospatial data and CRS handling
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr); library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(scales); library(forcats)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(gt)                 # tables
})

source("R/utils.R")
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)   # planar predicates: everything is in the projected CRS
set.seed(1234)

# ---- Load the prepared objects -----------------------------------------------
# Built by scripts/01_markets.R .. scripts/08_report_data.R.
DER <- "data/derived"
RP  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "report.rds"))
SC  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "scenario.rds"))
MC  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "mci.rds"))
AM  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "audit_markets.rds"))
AS  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "audit_stations.rds"))
AR  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "audit_ridership.rds"))
AF  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "audit_frames.rds"))
dE  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "dest_existing.rds"))
dP  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "dest_proposed.rds"))
origins <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "origins.rds"))
hex <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "hex_markets.rds"))
sz  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "subzone.rds"))
land <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "land.rds"))
cw  <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "street_crosswalk.rds"))
si_e <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "si_existing.rds"))
si_p <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "si_proposed.rds"))

NT <- SC$new_tbl; OT <- SC$old_tbl; TT <- SC$totals; SN <- SC$sens_tbl
LT <- RP$ladder_tbl
lad <- function(key) LT[grepl(key, LT$model, fixed = TRUE), ]
ch  <- function(par, term) par$estimate[par$term == term]
stn <- function(name, col, t = OT) t[[col]][t$station_name == name]

# Percentage changes keep their sign in the prose, with a true minus.
chg <- function(x, d = 0) sprintf("%s%s%%", ifelse(x >= 0, "+", "−"), formatC(abs(100 * x), format = "f", digits = d))
num <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d) |> str_replace("^-", "−")
rnd <- function(x, to = 100) n_fmt(round(x / to) * to)

JRL_NEW <- sum(NT$project == "JRL"); CRL_NEW <- sum(NT$project != "JRL")

# ---- One base for every map -----------------------------------------------------
# The western islands and Jurong Island's far end carry no stations and shrink the
# rest of the map, so the view stops at the main island's useful extent.
XL <- c(2500, 47500); YL <- c(21500, 50500)
map_base <- function(...) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = land, fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = "#d6d3d1", linewidth = 0.25) +
    list(...) +
    coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE, xlim = XL, ylim = YL) +
    theme_map(10)
}

# The rail network, drawn from the graph's own links.
links_old <- MC$links |> filter(!line %in% c("JS", "JE", "JW", "CR"))
links_new <- MC$links |> filter(line %in% c("JS", "JE", "JW", "CR"))
is_lrt <- function(l) l %in% c("BP", "SE", "SW", "PE", "PW")
net_layer <- function(col = "#a8a29e", lw = 0.35) {
  geom_segment(data = links_old, aes(x = ax, y = ay, xend = bx, yend = by),
               colour = col, linewidth = lw)
}
new_layer <- function(lw = 0.7) {
  geom_segment(data = links_new, aes(x = ax, y = ay, xend = bx, yend = by, colour = line),
               linewidth = lw, show.legend = FALSE)
}
```

# <span class="en">Summary</span><span class="zh">摘要</span> {.unnumbered}

::: {.en}
Singapore has opened stations a decade late because too few people stood to use them,
and is about to add `r JRL_NEW + CRL_NEW` new access points to its rail network. This
report calibrates a probabilistic spatial interaction model of average daily tap-ins at
the `r nrow(dE)` stations open in August and September 2026, then uses it to predict
ridership at the Jurong Region Line and Cross Island Line Phase 1 stations and the effect
on those already open.

A plain Huff model fails on these data: with equal attractiveness and a distance exponent
of −2, it explains less than a station's average would (R² = `r num(lad("M1")$insample)`). Three
changes make it useful. Ridership is split by the morning balance of tap-ins and
tap-outs into a home end and an activity end, each with its own market. Attractiveness
depends on retail, interchange status, mode and rail time to the CBD, and not on bus stops.
And the choice set stops at `r RP$DMAX` km, because otherwise a new station in Jurong
takes riders from Marina Bay. On lines left out of the calibration, the model
reaches an R² of `r num(lad("M8 ")$lolo_r2)` on the log scale, against `r num(lad("DRM")$lolo_r2)` for a direct
regression on the same variables.

The new stations are predicted to carry about `r rnd(TT$new_stations[1], 1000)` tap-ins a day, with a
wide range around any single station. Serangoon North, Choa Chu Kang West and Pasir Ris
East lead; Aviation Park, Jurong Pier and Tengah are the likeliest to fall below Hume, the
last station held back for lack of demand. Losses at existing stations
fade from `r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[1])` within a kilometre of a new station to nothing beyond 8 km.
They reach `r chg(stn("Pioneer", "chg_closed"))` at Pioneer. As value-added analysis, an outside option shows the
data cannot separate riders diverted from riders gained, and a multiplicative competitive
interaction model of OD shares shows the cost the station totals hide: about
`r rnd(MC$xfer$change[MC$xfer$station_name == "Boon Lay"], 1000)` transfers a day at Boon Lay, which has none today.
:::

::: {.zh}
新加坡曾有车站因使用者太少而推迟十年才开放，而如今又将为铁路网增加 `r JRL_NEW + CRL_NEW` 个
新进站点。本报告针对 2026 年 8、9 月开放的 `r nrow(dE)` 个车站的平均每日进站量，校准一个概率
空间交互模型，再用它预测裕廊区域线与跨岛线第一期车站的客流，以及对既有车站的影响。

朴素的 Huff 模型在这份数据上是失败的：吸引力相同、距离指数取 −2 时，它的解释力还不如直接
取各站平均值（R² = `r num(lad("M1")$insample)`）。三处改动使它变得可用。第一，依早高峰进出站的
平衡，把客流分为居住端与活动端，各有自己的市场。第二，吸引力取决于零售、换乘地位、制式与到 CBD 的
轨道时间，而与公交站数量无关。第三，选择集止于 `r RP$DMAX` 公里，否则裕廊的新站会从滨海湾抢走乘客。
在校准时被留出的线路上，模型在对数尺度上的 R² 达到 `r num(lad("M8 ")$lolo_r2)`，而基于相同变量的
直接回归只有 `r num(lad("DRM")$lolo_r2)`。

预计新站每日合计约有 `r rnd(TT$new_stations[1], 1000)` 次进站，单站的区间很宽。Serangoon North、
Choa Chu Kang West 与 Pasir Ris East 居前；Aviation Park、Jurong Pier 与 Tengah 最有可能低于
Hume（最近一个因需求不足而被推迟的车站）。既有车站的损失随距离衰减：距新站 1 公里内中位数为
`r chg(SC$by_distance$median_chg[1])`，8 公里外接近于零；Pioneer 最高，达 `r chg(stn("Pioneer", "chg_closed"))`。
作为附加价值分析，外部选项表明数据无法区分转移客流与新增客流；而基于 OD 份额的乘法竞争交互模型则显示了
车站总量所掩盖的代价：Boon Lay 今天没有换乘客流，届时每日约有
`r rnd(MC$xfer$change[MC$xfer$station_name == "Boon Lay"], 1000)` 次换乘。
:::
